pages.text: Health 75, Armor 6, Knockback Resistance 0.6, Attack 7, Speed 0.3.$(br)The guardians of an ancient prismarine temple that does not belong to this age; the craft that made them was lost long ago, yet by wedding it to the mighty magic of a Heart of the Sea you managed to recreate this powerful prismarine warrior.
Place a $(l)Vitality Pumpkin$() directly above the $(l)Prismarine Core$().

6, Attack 7, Speed 0.3.$(br)As a high-ranking guard it starts out with a full suit of armour and is armed with a bow, a sword or an axe; whichever weapon it carries, it can bring great force to bear and hew a path through the thorns on your road of black magic.$(br)You can right-click your Prismarine Soldier with Prismarine Shards, Prismarine or Prismarine Bricks to heal it.
